title: Contextual Hublet & Lenticular Navigation — Console IA prototype for dashboard/rollout/cost flows
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Design a compact, context-aware navigation pattern (working name: 'Hublet + Lenticular lanes') to surface dashboards, rollout controls, and cost breakdowns across workspaces with minimal cognitive load. The goal is to replace deep sidebar cascades with lightweight contextual panes that adapt to active routes and user role, improving discoverability for rollouts and cost lenses while keeping primary task flows (deploy, monitor, investigate) one click away.
objectives: Create a navigation model that shows per-route 'hublets' — small contextual hubs for dashboards, rollouts, and cost tools
Ensure workspace switching is fast (<200ms perceived) and preserves selected context (filters, model/version) across workspaces
Reduce sidebar depth and eliminate >2-level menus for common tasks
Prototype micro-interactions for progressive disclosure of cost breakdowns and rollout toggles
Validate with PM/Eng on impact to routing, analytics, and telemetry tagging
decisions: Opted for a hybrid left-rail + flyout hublet pattern instead of full top nav after early usability tests
Hublets will be route-coupled: presence and tile composition determined by route metadata returned by frontend route registry
Workspace switch persists 'active lens' (dashboard / rollouts / cost) unless user elects 'home' reset
Accessibility: hublet flyouts use ARIA role='dialog' with keyboard focus trap and skip links to main content
review_feedback: PM (Ethan Romero): prefer preserving active alerts filter when switching workspaces — avoid surprising drop of context
Eng (Samir Kaur): route metadata approach ok but needs a migration plan for older routes; suggested feature-flag rollout
SRE (Jordan Mills): confirm telemetry names for rollout toggles to map to SLO experiments
Design review: reduce animation time to 160ms for flyout open/close to meet perceived performance target
next_steps: Finalize route metadata schema and publish docs for front-end and backend teams
Sync with ENG-4512 (router-refactor) to add hublet hooks and initial migration strategy
Build a dark-theme accessibility pass and token map (contrast checks)
Schedule moderated usability test with 6 power users (mix of PMs, SREs, platform eng) — target week 2026-03-15
Create engineering spike: small server-side flag to return hublet composition for route (ENG-4583)
acceptance_criteria: Hublet flyout is visible on dashboard/rollout/cost routes and can be opened/closed with keyboard only
Workspace switch preserves selected lens across at least 90% of test flows
No existing primary task requires >2 clicks to reach from the new left-rail
Design tokens and contrast meet WCAG 2.1 AA for hublet components
Telemetry includes new metrics: hublet_open, hublet_action, workspace_switch_preserve (schema provided)
notes: Prototype surfaced surprising value for cost quick-glance card — product requested an expanded breakdown variant (inline drilldown)
Consider retro-fitting rollout canary controls into hublet tile (inline safeguard modal) rather than navigating to full rollout page
We will run A/B experiment comparing 'hublet' vs 'compact-sidebar' for conversion to safe-rollout within 4 weeks
